text:
Amelia: Design review for the API keys empty state — want to land a compact layout that gets devs creating keys fast. Figma: https://figma.com/file/efgh5678 (compact card + skeleton). Thoughts on CTA wording and the one-time secret warning?
Jordan: Lean towards short action label: 'Create API key' over 'Create your first API key'. Put CTA full-width on mobile, inline on desktop. Add a tiny secondary link 'Why do I need a key?' that opens a micro-help panel. :information_source:
Priya: Copy nit: one-time visibility line should be explicit and calm. Options: 'This secret is shown only once — copy or download it now.' or 'Youll only see this secret once; store it securely.' Prefer the latter.
Samir: Accessibility checklist: 1) Show/hide secret button must include context in aria-label (eg. 'Show secret for Service X'), 2) after the drawer closes, focus must go to the new key row, 3) do NOT auto-copy to clipboard (ask user), 4) toasts need aria-live and short content. Also ensure color contrast of scope pills meets AA.
Amelia: UX question: For the first key flow, do we surface permission scopes in the initial drawer or keep them minimal with an 'edit scopes' step after creation? My instinct: keep creation fast and let users tweak scopes immediately after via an inline editor.
Jordan: Agree on fast path. Show default scope pill(s) in the drawer (read-only/embedding) so user understands the default, but hide advanced scope controls under 'Customize scopes'.
Priya: For the ephemeral secret reveal, propose an ephemeral banner below the secret line: 'This secret is shown only once — copy now or download a .txt' + small 'Copy' and 'Download' buttons. Banner should include an 'I understand' checkbox to remind users.
Samir: On revoke/rotate flows: show a pre-action checklist listing dependent integrations (best-effort). If dependencies found, surface a confirm modal. Otherwise allow inline rotate with 'Rotate & notify' primary. Add a soft-revoke undo window (6s toast with Undo).
Amelia: Which pattern do we use for rotation confirmation? Inline expansion or modal? Lean inline for speed, modal when dependencies exist. We can implement both: inline with eventual modal fallback.
Jordan: Pattern library updates: I'll add compact-card, full-width CTA variant, pill styles, and the secret banner pattern. Will include a11y notes in the component docs.
ux-bot: Run aXe and color contrast checks on the branch. Add automated keyboard tests for focus after drawer close and for secret reveal keyboard-only flows.
Priya: Small copy tweak suggestion: change 'store it securely' -> 'save it in a secure location' (more actionable).
Samir: I'll open an a11y PR with aria-labels and aria-live regions + keyboard tests. Also adding three copy variants into the Figma comments for quick research.
Amelia: Action list: Samir - a11y PR and tests; Jordan - component & pattern updates; Priya - final copy options; Amelia - sign off and schedule 3-dev usability quick test. Target: EOD Tuesday for copy, Wednesday for pattern merge, Thursday morning quick tests. Thanks all.
